cytra-shulkerview.settings.title: Shulker View
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemIcon.hint: Shows the item inside when every stack is the same item
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemBar.hint: A bar along the bottom of the slot showing how full the shulker is
cytra-shulkerview.option.mixedIcon.hint: Icon for boxes with more than one item type, on items and placed boxes
cytra-shulkerview.option.itemIconSize.hi: Share of the slot the icon covers
Hovering a shulker (or another container item) shows its contents as a slot grid instead of the text list
ShulkerBoxTooltip is installed and shows its own preview
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipShiftOnl: Like ShulkerBoxTooltip: the tooltip says "Shift: preview" until you hold Shift
Compact merges the same items, most first; Full shows every stack in its slot. Alt+Shift shows the other one
cytra-shulkerview.option.placedLabels.hi: Icon and fill bar on the four side faces, like an item frame
cytra-shulkerview.option.placedLabelsLid: Also shows the label on top of the box (the lid), hidden while it's open
Labels further away than this many blocks are not drawn
Share of the face the icon covers
cytra-shulkerview.option.namedTextures.h: Uses Alloy Pack textures on placed shulkers named Trash, Tools, Food or Blocks
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipStyle.hi: Vanilla: grey container window like ShulkerBoxTooltip. Alloy: the dark Alloy panel
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipTint.hin: Tints the preview window with the shulker box's colour
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipOtherCon: Also previews chests, barrels, hoppers, furnaces and dispensers that hold items (e.g. Ctrl+pick block in creative)
cytra-shulkerview.option.tooltipEnderChe: Ender chest items preview your own ender chest. Needs this mod on the server, or opening your ender chest once
